title: Atomize Charge Panorama — token-level cost insights & pricing patterns
creator: Maya Robinson
description: Design and prototype a compact, scalable token-level cost analytics surface — 'Atomize Charge Panorama' — that surfaces per-call token breakdowns, attribution to prompt components (system, instructions, user turns, tools), and pricing pattern controls (rate bands, per-route overrides). Includes CSV/NDJSON export flows, role-aware masking for PII, and a lightweight explorer that can be embedded in the Console dashboards and per-route pages.
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity Figma screens for dashboard card, expanded inspector, and export modal are available
Interactive prototype demonstrates drilldown from route-level summary to per-token sequence view and attribution lanes
Export flow supports up to 5000 rows with a server-side job UX and shows estimated runtime/size
PM and Eng have signed off on data contract (fields required for attribution) and agreed sampling strategy
Design tokens and components follow Console system — responsive card, table, sparklines, and compact attribution chips
updates: 2025-02-20: Kickoff — aligned scope with PM/Analytics on fields and export use cases (cost audit, chargeback, SLA reports)
2025-02-24: First wireframes delivered — focused on compact dashboard card with 3-level drilldown (summary -> session -> token sequence)
2025-02-27: Engineering feasibility review — Eng raised concerns about computing full per-token attribution for long sessions; suggested pre-aggregation and TTL caching
2025-03-01: PM feedback — prioritize export UX for enterprise customers and allow role-based column visibility; added 'estimated export size' and warning states

2025-03-04: Design critique — team prefers attribution lanes with color-coded chips and hover previews instead of dense tables; accessibility review requested for color contrast and keyboard navigation
2025-03-05: Built interactive prototype (Figma + ProtoPie) for stakeholder demo; collecting engineering estimates for server-side job and permissions model
decisions: Use three-level drilldown as primary navigation (card -> session pane -> token sequence inspector) to keep main dashboard lightweight
Adopt server-side pre-aggregation for 30/90/365 day windows to keep query latency under 500ms for summary cards
Export large payloads as background job with email/console notification; immediate CSV preview limited to first 200 rows
Role-aware exports: admins see full prompt text; viewer roles receive masked prompt content and token-level anonymized hashes
Pricing controls UI will surface suggested rate bands computed by Optimize team, with an override toggle per-route
blockers: Finalized telemetry schema from Runtime team (fields: token_source, token_count, model_variant, prompt_component_ids)
Auth/permissions gating for masked exports requires Security API change tracked in ENG-7012
Decision on default sampling rate for heavy historical queries (Sampling vs Full-fidelity)
next_steps: Address Eng blocking items: schedule data contract sync with Runtime and Analytics (owner: Ethan, due 2025-03-07)
Implement accessibility pass on prototype and produce annotated specs for dev handoff (owner: Maya, due 2025-03-09)
Create a minimal frontend spike to render the summary card with cached mock data to validate layout and performance (owner: Eng-Frontend, estimate 3d)
Prepare rollout plan: canary to 10% of orgs with export feature disabled by default; collect telemetry and CLTV signals (owner: PM Priya Shah)
Draft copy for export modal and masking explanations to reduce customer support churn
